latestVersion.changelog:
Windows Security Hardening Tool 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Professional API for generating automated Windows security hardening configurations.
- Supports dynamic, policy-based configuration generation with audit and compliance features.
- Provides endpoints for health checks, configuration generation, and retrieval of available hardening options.
- Includes support for common security frameworks (CIS, NIST, DoD STIGs) and organizational compliance needs.
- Offers session-based tracking, user identification, and extensive pricing tiers for varying usage requirements.
